say:1:1510260001:0.text: Herdmaster, will you proclaim a new decree?
say:1:1510260001:0.source_cn: 狩猎神大人，您还要宣布新的令法吗？
say:1:1510260001:0.male: Herdmaster, will you proclaim a new decree?
say:1:1510260001:0.female: Herdmaster, will you proclaim a new decree?

choice_prompt:2:1510260001.text: Herdmaster, will you proclaim a new decree?
choice_prompt:2:1510260001.source_cn: 狩猎神大人，您还要宣布新的令法吗？
choice_prompt:2:1510260001.male: Herdmaster, will you proclaim a new decree?
choice_prompt:2:1510260001.female: Herdmaster, will you proclaim a new decree?

say:3:1510260002:0.text: Understood. I will follow your instructions.
say:3:1510260002:0.source_cn: 是。加拉会遵照您之前的叮嘱。
say:3:1510260002:0.male: Understood. I will follow your instructions.
say:3:1510260002:0.female: Understood. I will follow your instructions.

narration:4:1510260003:0.text: Under the gaze of the crowd, little Gala steps forward alone.
narration:4:1510260003:0.source_cn: 众目睽睽下，瘦小的加拉一个人站了出来

say:5:1510260004:0.text: The Hunting God has a new decree.
say:5:1510260004:0.source_cn: 狩猎神大人有新的圣示。
say:5:1510260004:0.male: The Hunting God has a new decree.
say:5:1510260004:0.female: The Hunting Goddess has a new decree.

say:6:1510260005:0.text: From this day onward, the wounded and the feeble will be cared for.
say:6:1510260005:0.source_cn: 从今天开始，雅库伯尔的伤者与弱者，需要得到照顾。

say:9:1510260007:0.text: The Wildborn need more warriors and foragers! No more weaklings! Those who contribute nothing should be cast out!
say:9:1510260007:0.source_cn: 雅库伯尔需要战士、采集者和饲育者！他们什么都不是！

say:10:1510260008:0.text: They will have their own place.

say:14:1510260009:0.text: Some Wildborn call you nothing. Tell them what the Hunting God has revealed to you.
say:14:1510260009:0.source_cn: 你们是什么？说出狩猎神大人的启示。
say:14:1510260009:0.male: Some Wildborn call you nothing. Tell them what the Hunting God has revealed to you.
say:14:1510260009:0.female: Some Wildborn call you nothing. Tell them what the Hunting Goddess has revealed to you.

say:15:1510260010:0.text: I... was gonna end it all. But the Exalted One told me I should stay and teach the younglings how to fight smarter.
say:15:1510260010:0.source_cn: 俺……俺本来打算去死，但狩猎神大人说，俺可以教会部落的...
say:15:1510260010:0.male: I... was gonna end it all. But the Exalted One told me I should stay and teach the younglings how to fight smarter.
say:15:1510260010:0.female: I... was gonna end it all. But the Exalted One told me I should stay and teach the younglings how to fight smarter.

say:16:1510260011:0.text: That way they won't be tricked by the Halians like I was!
say:16:1510260011:0.source_cn: 他们就不会像俺一样，再中呼临人的伎俩！

say:17:1510260012:0.text: The Hunting God and his emissary saw what I could do. I've learned how to drain the rot from wounds and discovered herbs that can stop the bleeding for our warriors...
say:17:1510260012:0.source_cn: 狩猎神大人和神使见证，我已经学会弄走伤口的脓疮，找到了...
say:17:1510260012:0.male: The Hunting God and his emissary saw what I could do. I've learned how to drain the rot from wounds and discovered herbs that can stop the bleeding for our warriors...
say:17:1510260012:0.female: The Hunting Goddess and her emissary saw what I could do. I've learned how to drain the rot from wounds and discovered herbs that can stop the bleeding for our warriors...

say:18:1510260013:0.text: I may not be able to hunt, but I can still help!
say:18:1510260013:0.source_cn: 我，虽然没法再捕猎，但可以帮助大家！

say:21:1510260014:0.text: Their positions will be teachers and healers.
say:21:1510260014:0.source_cn: 教者和医者，是他们的新位置。

choice_prompt:22:1510260014.text: Their positions will be teachers and healers.
choice_prompt:22:1510260014.source_cn: 教者和医者，是他们的新位置。

say:24:1510260015:0.text: The Wildborn will heed the words of the Wild Moon.
say:24:1510260015:0.source_cn: 狩猎神的神谕，雅库伯尔听从。
say:24:1510260015:0.male: The Wildborn will heed the words of the Wild Moon.
say:24:1510260015:0.female: The Wildborn will heed the words of the Wild Moon.

say:25:1510260016:0.text: Hoof, Silky Ears, the Herdmaster has decided your fate.
say:25:1510260016:0.source_cn: 蹄与绒耳，兽群之主决定了你们的去留。
say:25:1510260016:0.male: Hoof, Silky Ears, the Herdmaster has decided your fate.
say:25:1510260016:0.female: Hoof, Silky Ears, the Herdmaster has decided your fate.

say:26:1510260017:0.text: By blood and breath, honor him for the rest of your lives.
say:26:1510260017:0.source_cn: 用你们未来的生命，维护<male>他</male><f...
say:26:1510260017:0.male: By blood and breath, honor him for the rest of your lives.
say:26:1510260017:0.female: By blood and breath, honor her for the rest of your lives.

say:37:1510260020:0.text: Now, the Hunting God will honor the tribe's greatest warrior with a divine weapon blessed with his radiance!
say:37:1510260020:0.source_cn: 接下来，狩猎神要将荣耀赐予部落最强的勇士——神赐的武器！
say:37:1510260020:0.male: Now, the Hunting God will honor the tribe's greatest warrior with a divine weapon blessed with his radiance!
say:37:1510260020:0.female: Now, the Hunting Goddess will honor the tribe's greatest warrior with a divine weapon blessed with her radiance!

choice:22:0:1.text: Yes, this is how it should be.
choice:22:0:1.male: Yes, this is how it should be.
choice:22:0:1.female: Yes, this is how it should be.

choice:22:1:2.text: Does anyone have anything else to say?
choice:22:1:2.male: Does anyone have anything else to say?
choice:22:1:2.female: Does anyone have anything else to say?

choice:22:2:3.text: I am the Hunting God. Heed me.
choice:22:2:3.male: I am the Hunting God. Heed me.
choice:22:2:3.female: I am the Hunting Goddess. Heed me.

choice:2:0:1.text: You will announce it for me.
choice:2:0:1.male: You will announce it for me.
choice:2:0:1.female: You will announce it for me.

choice:2:1:2.text: Yes, we've waited for this moment.
choice:2:1:2.source_cn: 等待这么久，就为了这一刻！
choice:2:1:2.male: Yes, we've waited for this moment.
choice:2:1:2.female: Yes, we've waited for this moment.

choice:2:2:3.text: Go. It's time to bend them to my will.
choice:2:2:3.male: Go. It's time to bend them to my will.
choice:2:2:3.female: Go. It's time to bend them to my will.
